description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Endpoint' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the Core API v2. It provides a base implementation for API endpoint classes, managing request handling, parameter validation, sorting, pagination, and error handling. It includes methods for initializing request objects, setting search and sorting parameters, and retrieving API request attributes.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for API endpoints that manages request data, validation, sorting, pagination, and attribute retrieval within the OrangeHRM Core APIv2 framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request object and request parameters, and calls the init method for further setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: A protected lifecycle hook method intended to be overridden by child classes for additional initialization.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Returns the current request parameters object.

methods.name: setRequestParams
methods.description: Sets the request parameters object; internal method.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the validation decorator object used for validating request parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Configures the search parameter holder with sorting and pagination details extracted from the request, applying default values if necessary.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for sorting, pagination, and optionally sorting field based on allowed values.

methods.name: getAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'id' attribute from request parameters used for identifying specific resources.

search-terms: abstract PHP class for API endpoints
